purpose: Designate the pretrained-SGD, source-disjoint SeaDronesSee E0-E3 family as the official paper mainline while keeping alpha selection as an in-mainline ablation.

intentional_differences.pretrained: true from the locked yolov8s.pt instead of random initialization

alignment_with_historical_local_sgd.comparison_boundary: Because the dataset protocol and runtime environment also differ, historical-local versus official-mainline metrics are not a strict pretrained-only ablation.
